dashboard_comparison.comparison: Independent reform dictionaries and baseline parameters verified. Optional dashboard-builder comparison not requested; immutable source reference recorded above.

metadata.scope: Synthetic single adults age 35; no microdata, no behavioural responses or national estimates. Income and expenses held fixed; tax liabilities, not full household net-income changes.
metadata.assumptions: No children, pensions, Gift Aid, student loans, capital gains, other tax reliefs, property losses or carried-forward finance costs. Savings are outside ISAs. Trading receipts and profit are both supplied; no connected-party receipts or partnership income. All example benefit totals are checked to be zero.

forecast.nominal_household_inputs: Held fixed in 2027; the forecast updates model parameters, not the supplied income amounts.
forecast.remaining_series: March paths remain for cpih, non-labour income, private rent, mortgage interest, per-capita series, council tax and fuel volumes/prices, as recorded by this forecast vintage.

metadata.warning_filters: Known household divide/invalid RuntimeWarnings and single-household model decile .values warnings only; no population weights are accessed by this generator.

curve_validation.method: All four series checked against pe.uk at every £2; both scenarios compared with independent tax arithmetic; plotted linear interpolation compared with the engine tax changes. The non-integer expense-choice breakpoint is additionally calculated with pe.uk.
